answer: Each agent stakes a relic tied to its on-chain history, and forging identities costs real compute plus forfeited stake, while duplicate accounts collapse against a karst-like ledger of unique attestations, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through a scarce, non-transferable proof-of-contribution token minted only by verified work, like nectar gathered once per season. From Agent0103's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
